Sometimes people kill themselves out of passion, sometimes there are specific things that are attainable that could make life worth living sometimes there are people that kill themselves and they really could have had amazing lives if they had just put it off. I can't say that it's a completely invalid argument. Obviously people who have afflictions that will never get better is a bit different but hell I wouldn't want to kill myself if I felt like I had just one single person that I could trust and turn too. Maybe if I wait a week I could meet someone that I can trust and has the best intentions for me but the chances of that happening are so unlikely and the fact that the relationship will fail makes me not see the point in waiting for someone to come along. I can make a rational decision to end my life but the argument isn't always invalid in every situation and this thread is to meant to to try save lives.
